title: WordPress themes ported from JoomlArt templates are named "WP <Name>" (Nova, Vega, Morgan, Kinetic, Impact)
steps: S1: For each of wp-ja-nova, wp-ja-vega, wp-ja-morgan, wp-ja-kinetic, wp-ja-impact read, in both overlays/<slug> and src/<slug> of packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme: the Theme Name line of style.css, the first line of readme.txt, the label of register_block_pattern_category in inc/extra.php, and themeName in overlays/<slug>/theme.config.json.
S2: In the same files count lines that still carry the old name in those four places.
expect: S1: each reads "WP <Name>" (WP Nova, WP Vega, WP Morgan, WP Kinetic, WP Impact).
evidence: Before this change WordPress listed the five themes as "JA <Name>" under Appearance > Themes
fence: Static read of the name in the committed overlay and built theme trees; the build check keeps the two trees in step
